subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` enforce a hard 4 MiB public limit for existing users?
rationale: The security direction is sound, but the exact cap becomes a shipped CLI contract and can reject previously accepted prompt files.

options.title: Keep 4 MiB With Docs
options.body: Keep the cap, fix the regression errors/tests, and document the limit as the supported safe input size.

options.title: Choose A Larger Cap
options.body: Raise the cap before merge if maintainers expect very large local prompt files to remain accepted.

options.title: Defer The Cap
options.body: Pause the PR until the CLI input-limit policy is decided for all file-backed command inputs.

recommendation.title: Keep 4 MiB With Docs
recommendation.body: Keep the cap, fix the regression errors/tests, and document the limit as the supported safe input size.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest routing history for the gateway-backed agent CLI surface and merged the current command implementation.
